contexts.text: A certain Church which came into existence in Syrian, being instituted by Eber, which is to be called the Second Ancient Church. Treated of.
The First Ancient Church extended through Syria, etc. AC 2385:5. AE 422:20.
Afterwards, in Syria, there commenced a certain external worship...
Those who dwelt in Syria were called sons of the east.
Balaam was from Syria, where had lived Eber, or whence came the Hebrew nation.
Besides other nations in Syria which were from Nahor.

Terah and Abram... worshipped other gods, and had no knowledge... of the good and truth of faith; and had thus become better fitted to receive the seed of truth than others in Syria, among whom Knowledges as yet remained. That they did remain with some, is evident from Balaam, who was from Syria... AC 1675:5.
Damascus was the principal city of Syria, where there were remains of the Ancient Church, and whence came Eber, or the Hebrew nation, with which there was nothing but the external of the Church.
In Syria, whence came Abram, there still remained remains of the Ancient Church, and many families there retained the worship, as is evident from Eber...
From this it is evident that the laud whence Abram came was Syria, where was the Second Ancient Church, which was called Hebrew from Eber...

As by the Syrians, or the sons of the east, were signified those in the Knowledges of good and truth, they... were called the wise. Illustrated... As in Matthew where it is said... Wise men from the east came to Jerusalem...
For in Syria were the last remains of the Ancient Church, and therefore in that land the Knowledges of good and truth were still preserved, as may be evident from Balaam...
When Jacob went into Syria, he is said to have gone to the land of the sons of the east (). AC 3762.

That by Syria, in general, are signified the Knowledges of good. References. But here it is not said that Jacob went to Aram, or Syria, but to the land of the sons of the east, in order to signify... an ascent to the truths of love.
Jegar-sahadutha, means the heap of the witness, in the idiom of Syria, whence Laban came.
The Hebrew Church was in Syria and Mesopotamia, and also among some nations in Canaan.

By the king of Syria (who sent chariots and horsemen and a great army to take Elisha) () are represented those who are in the Knowledges of truth; here, in the opposite, those in Knowledges not of truth.
Rezin king of Syria () = the Knowledges of evil. That Syria = the Knowledges of good. References. Thus, in the opposite, it = the Knowledges of evil.
Syrians from Kir () = those in the Knowledges of good and truth, which they have perverted. References.
That by Syria are signified the Knowledges of truth and good. References.
Syria is thy trader... () = ... the Knowledges of good (which are) the truths of celestial love. AE 717:10.
The manner of writing of the Arabians, Syrians, and Greeks...
How it was that the science of correspondences came to be cultivated in Syria, etc. DSS 102.
The Ancient Word existed in Syria, etc.
Syria = the Church as to the Knowledges of truth and good.
That altars were in use in Syria, from which Abram came. Illustrated.
Cephas, in the Syriac language, means a rock.
Naaman a leper of Syria () = those who falsify the Knowledges of good and truth from the Word; for... Syria = the Knowledges of good and truth.

Rezin, and Syria () = a perverted Rational... It is the Rational in respect to knowledges which confirm, which is signified by Rezin and Syria; for a man cannot have understanding of the Word unless he has a Rational...
The king of Syria (who made war upon Ahaz) () = the external or Natural of the Church.
The idolatry and magic which then existed in Syria, etc.
